_note: CMP-09 Navigation + CMP-10 Footer. Page '02 — Components', section 'CMP-09/10 Navigation & footer' (14:1015) at X=33000,Y=0. Use I(id, {variant}, {prop: value}). Shell widths follow conventions §4 (casino shell): Nav/Sidebar 240/72, Nav/Topbar + Nav/App Topbar 1200 default (set FILL in screens). Per-variant text is unbound — override TEXT layers by name (e.g. 'Page title' in Nav/Topbar, 'Current page' / 'Crumb N' in Nav/Breadcrumb).

Nav/Sidebar Item.note: 216x40 expanded (FILL inside sidebar), 48x40 collapsed (tooltip on Hover). Nested Badge/Count layer 'Count' — set its Count prop on the nested instance.

Nav/Sidebar.note: Casino-shell / dashboard sidebar 240 (expanded) / 72 (collapsed) x 1024; set FILL height in screens. Platform: Overview(active), Wallet, Global Pool, Games; Account: Account & Security, Financial history, VIP, Referrals, Responsible gaming, Notifications(3). Bottom RG card + 18+.

Nav/Topbar.note: Dashboard topbar 1200x72 (FILL, >= 1176). Breadcrumb slot + 'Page title' TEXT, Wallet/Balance Chip (14:2062), Network Pill (Connected only), bell+count, Button/Wallet, avatar trigger.

Nav/App Topbar.note: Casino-shell top bar to the right of Nav/Sidebar (public/lobby/games/pool pages), 1200x72 FILL. Input/Search + auth or balance/Deposit/bell/avatar; Restricted region adds Nav/Region Banner on top.

Nav/Breadcrumb.note: 2 = Dashboard > Wallet, 3 = Dashboard > Wallet > Withdraw, 4 = Admin > Finance > Withdrawals > WD-20931 (Mono + DEMO). Override TEXT layers 'Crumb N' / 'Current page'.

Nav/Step Item.note: 120 wide default; FILL inside steppers. Hide leading line on step 1, trailing on last.

Nav/Stepper.note: Steps=7 deposit (Network, Token, Address, QR, Pending, Confirmation, Done), 840 wide; Steps=9 withdraw (Asset, Network, Address, Amount, Fees, Risk check, 2FA, Pending, Done), 1080 wide. Current 1..N. For a failed step swap that nested Step Item to State=Error (example frame 15:3126).

Nav/Stepper Mobile.note: 358 wide compact stepper: current label + 'Step X of N' + segmented bar + 'Next:' hint (texts per instance).

Nav/Header Link.note: 72 tall public-header link; Active = 2px brand underline at the bottom edge. Show chevron for the 'More' priority+ overflow.

Nav/Balance Chip.note: COMPACT available-balance chip (9,215.30 USDT + DEMO) for space-constrained public headers. Where space allows use Wallet/Balance Chip 14:2062.

Nav/Region Banner.note: Regional restriction banner (United States restricted, DEMO). Pin above the header, FILL width. Not dismissible.

Header/Public Desktop.note: 1440x72 (+65 banner in Restricted region). Logged-in states use priority+ nav (How It Works + Affiliates under 'More').

Header/Public Mobile.note: 390x64: logo / logo mark, one account or wallet control, menu button.

Menu/Mobile Fullscreen.note: 390 wide open-state menu (hug height ~927/1100, scrolls in product): nav list, Log in/Register or account card, Connect Wallet, language, RG + 18+ card, home indicator.

Nav/Mobile Tab Bar.note: 390x83 (49 tabs + 34 home indicator); Account shows unread count.

Nav/Admin Item.note: 232 wide dense rows (Group 32, Child 30). No access = role-based lock. Nested Badge/Count 'Count'.

Nav/Admin Sidebar.note: 248x1024 admin shell sidebar: PROD tag, 10 groups (Finance expanded, Withdrawals active 37, Compliance 214, Marketing + System no access), A. Marin / Finance Lead role chip, environment footer.

Nav/Admin Topbar.note: 1192x64 (FILL): env badge, command trigger '⌘K', 4-eyes approvals (4), alerts (5), A. Marin + Finance Lead.

Nav/Command Palette.note: 640 wide admin ⌘K palette; groups Users / Transactions / Rounds / Actions (allowed, audited actions only); keyboard hints footer. Place over scrim/overlay.

Footer.note: Mega footer 1440 / 768 / 390: brand + description + 18+ + neutral X/Telegram/Discord placeholders, Product/Games/Company/Legal (mobile = accordion, Legal open), help organisations card, 5 network pills (DEMO) + status page, licence & jurisdiction (Notice/Licence + DEMO placeholders), copyright + language. On mobile add 83px bottom space for the tab bar.
